breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to substitute the actual varying area function A(x) = A0·(1 + k·x/L) directly into the integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx, without replacing it with an arithmetic mean area. This matches the ground truth approach and eliminates the erroneous approximation present in the incomplete prompt.
